short: A multifunctional polymeric coating incorporating lawsone wi
title: A multifunctional polymeric coating incorporating lawsone with corrosion resistance and antibacterial activity for biomedical Mg alloys

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Biodegradable Mg implants corrode too fast and risk infection; a coating must slow corrosion and fight bacteria. Loading the natural inhibitor lawsone into a PCL coating should raise corrosion resistance and add antibacterial activity.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/modification), n5 (DES/architecture), n6 (PRC/treatment), n7 (PRC/deposition)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Alkali treatment leaves a hydroxyl-rich Mg(OH)2 oxide layer on the AZ31 surface. PCL-LS coating fully and uniformly covers the pretreated substrate without visible defects.
states.detail: Absorbed: n8 (STR/chemistry/bonding), n9 (STR/microstructure/distribution), n10 (STR/chemistry/composition). Premises: A sharp IR band near 3700 cm-1 is free O-H stretching of Mg(OH)2; ATR-FTIR samples less than ~1 um of the surface

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Corrosion resistance in Hank's solution ranks AZ31 < AZ31-OH < PCL < PCL-LS; PCL-LS is the noblest. The PCL layer acts as a physical barrier that blocks electrolyte penetration to the Mg substrate.
states.detail: Absorbed: n11 (PRP/value), n12 (MEC/pathway), n13 (MEC/pathway), n14 (PRP/value), n16 (PRP/value). Premises: More positive OCP/Ecorr means a nobler surface; larger low-frequency |Z| and arc diameter mean better corrosion protection; Lawsone forms insoluble complexes with metal ions on corroding surfaces

states.title: Performance state
states.head: In 7-day Hank's immersion at 37 C, PCL-LS best protects AZ31: least H2, smallest pH rise, nearly intact surface
states.detail: Absorbed: n15 (PRF/service_capability). Premises: Mg corrosion releases one H2 and two OH- per Mg, so H2 volume and pH rise track corrosion

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: A PCL/lawsone bilayer coating gives biomedical AZ31 both durable corrosion protection and antibacterial activity

nodes.title: XRD, F7, F9
nodes.head: Pure PCL |Z| at 0.01 Hz falls from ~10^5.5 (0 d) to ~10^5.05, 10^4.6 and 10^4.3 ohm cm2 after 1, 3, 7 days. PCL-LS |Z| at 0.01 Hz drops only from ~10^6.25 to ~10^5.85 ohm cm2 over 7 days.
nodes.solves: PCL-LS keeps its barrier impedance over 7 days of immersion while pure PCL loses it steadily
nodes.note: 7-d PCL phase goes slightly negative below 0.1 Hz, consistent with the inductive feature named in text panel F7c not cited: its OCR cue class is XRD, incompatible with ECHEM; read from whole F7. Text says phase 'remained quite stable'; only the top decade is stable band labels 1723 cm-1 and PO4 3- are author annotations; linked text never discusses F9C
nodes.detail: o14: Pure PCL |Z| at 0.01 Hz falls from ~10^5.5 (0 d) to ~10^5.05, 10^4.6 and 10^4.3 ohm cm2 after 1, 3, 7 days; o15: PCL-LS |Z| at 0.01 Hz drops only from ~10^6.25 to ~10^5.85 ohm cm2 over 7 days; o16: Pure PCL high-frequency phase falls (~72 to ~24 deg at 10^4.8 Hz) and a 1-10 Hz time constant grows with immersion; o17: PCL-LS phase at 10^4.8 Hz stays 77-88 deg over 7 days, but the 10^3 Hz plateau drops from ~40 to ~17 deg at 7 d; o21: After 7 days the PO4 band dominates bare and treated AZ31; the 1723 cm-1 C=O band stays strong on PCL-LS but weakens on PCL
nodes.inner_audit: o21: band labels 1723 cm-1 and PO4 3- are author annotations; linked text never discusses F9C
